Can you write a Python function to calculate Fibonacci numbers and analyze its time complexity?

Here is an optimized Python function using memoization:

def fibonacci(n: int, memo={}) -> int:
    if n in memo:
        return memo[n]
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    memo[n] = fibonacci(n - 1, memo) + fibonacci(n - 2, memo)
    return memo[n]
